text:
— rendering —

  ok   timecodes rendered

  ok   clicking the last word splits it off
  ok   first half
  ok   second half

— action buttons —
  ok   delete button removes the segment
  ok   clicking the icon inside Split does not also seek

— seek —
  ok   index seeks
  ok   timecode seeks
  ok   clicking the row seeks

— edit —
  ok   double-click opens a textarea
  ok   Enter saves and collapses whitespace
  ok   textarea is gone after saving

— selection —
  ok   one segment is selected
  ok   selecting another moves it, not adds
  ok   the right one is selected

— delegation survives rebuilds —
  ok   still exactly one handler after five rebuilds

— empty state —
  ok   shows an empty state
  ok   no segments rendered
  ok   no source line before the probe answers
  ok   source line appears once known
  ok   names the sequence
  ok   says how much speech
  ok   a missing sequence is flagged, not silent
  ok   sequence name is escaped, not executed
  ok   and it is still shown to the user as text

— scale —
  ok   renders 800 segments
        800-segment render: 143.5 ms
  ok   under 400 ms
